recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-26375 unless OO reopens the current Device status model in a new Jira; future work should start from Device.status, Device.availabilityStatus, and DeviceAssociation.associationStatus rather than the superseded R5-era Device operational/association status elements.
issue_request: FHIR-26375 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request for R5 asking to complete a missed piece of the FHIR-21235 Device status resolution from the September 2019 OO WGM minutes, described in the seed as adding Device.etcStatus with value and reason subelements.
initial_application: The related Device status change was applied before this reconciliation. Commit a7f2575daa recorded Device updates with FHIR-21235 preapplied, and the historical Device spreadsheet had Device.operationalStatus and Device.associationStatus backbone elements with value and reason subelements. FHIR-26375 itself had no separate Jira-keyed source commit, but the Jira comments later recognized that operational and association status already existed.
additional_context: Later final Device decisions changed the model. FHIR-36195 revised Device.operationalStatus to Device.operationalState, FHIR-32557/FHIR-34542 clarified Device.status as record status and added Device.availabilityStatus, and FHIR-46962 explicitly corrected R6 narrative because operationalStatus and associationStatus no longer exist on Device. Current active source defines Device.status and Device.availabilityStatus on Device, and association-state semantics live on DeviceAssociation.associationStatus.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Reintroducing Device.etcStatus, Device.operationalStatus, or Device.associationStatus into current Device would contradict later published/applied Jira decisions and the active R6 source structure.
